title: 「Put simply」簡單來說句
titleEn: Using put simply to restate a complex idea clearly

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

example: Put simply, the system failed because nobody took responsibility.
exampleZh: 簡單來說，這個制度失敗，是因為沒有人負責。

examples.en: Put simply, the system failed because nobody took responsibility.
examples.zh: 簡單來說，這個制度失敗，是因為沒有人負責。

rules.zh: Put simply 通常放在句首
rules.en: Put simply normally appears at the beginning of a sentence.
examples: Put simply, the plan will not work.

rules.zh: simply 後面要加逗號 正確： 錯誤：
後面必須接完整句子 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Follow it with a complete sentence, not an isolated phrase.

rules.zh: put 在這裏不是「放置」 在這個句型中，put 的意思是「表達」或「說明」。 因此，Put simply 的意思接近： 不過，本練習的所有答案必須使用指定形式：
rules.en: Put does not mean ‘place’ in this expression; it means ‘express’ or ‘explain’. Put simply is close to In simple terms, In other words, To put it simply and Simply put, but every answer in this exercise must use the specified form Put simply, ....

rules.zh: 不可用來引入無關的新觀點 Put simply 後面的內容應該是前面資料的簡化版本、主要意思或清楚結論，而不是突然轉到另一 個話題。
rules.en: Do not use put simply to introduce an unrelated new point. What follows must simplify the preceding information, state its main meaning or give a clear conclusion rather than abruptly changing the subject.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能提醒聽者或讀者：接下來就是整段內容最重要的意思。
benefits.en: It makes the main point immediately clear. This structure tells the listener or reader that the most important message is coming next.

benefits.zh: 當你解釋技術性、複雜或陌生的內容後，可以用這個句型把內容說得更容易明白。
benefits.en: It makes difficult explanations easier to understand. You can use it after discussing a technical, complicated or unfamiliar subject to restate the content more accessibly.

benefits.zh: 你不需要重複所有細節，也可以用一句清楚的句子說出核心意思。
benefits.en: It helps you shorten a long explanation. Instead of repeating every detail, you can present the central idea in one clear sentence.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能把詳細解釋和最後總結清楚分開，讓說話、作文、報告和簡報更有組織。
benefits.en: It helps organize speaking and writing by clearly separating a detailed explanation from its final summary, improving the structure of speech, essays, reports and presentations.

benefits.zh: 它讓你不必經常重複使用 in other words、basically 或 the main point is。 Compare 比較
benefits.en: It gives you another way to express a summary and avoids repeatedly using in other words, basically or the main point is.
examples: The company spends more money than it earns. In other words, it is losing money.
Put simply, the company is losing money because it spends more than it earns.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

en: Rewrite each sentence or pair of sentences using Put simply at the beginning. Preserve all important meaning.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
zh: 使用置於句首的 Put simply 改寫以下句子。答案須保留原句所有重要意思。
每題已提供答案的第一個字。

questions.prompt: The city may build more roads, yet traffic will continue to grow if more people choose to drive. The underlying message is that road building alone cannot solve congestion.
questions.promptZh: 城市可能興建更多道路，但如果更多人選擇駕駛，交通流量仍會繼續增加。背後的意思是，單靠興建道路不能解決擠塞問題。
questions.answer: Put simply, building more roads alone cannot solve congestion if more people continue to choose to drive.

questions.prompt: The research found a link between heavy screen use and poor sleep, but it did not prove that one directly caused the other. In plain terms, the two are connected, but causation has not been established.
questions.promptZh: 研究發現長時間使用屏幕與睡眠質素欠佳之間存在關聯，但沒有證明其中一項直接導致另一項。簡單來說，兩者有關聯，但因果關係尚未獲得證實。
questions.answer: Put simply, heavy screen use and poor sleep are connected, but the research did not prove that one causes the other.
questions.answerZh: 簡單來說，長時間使用屏幕與睡眠質素欠佳有所關聯，但研究沒有證明其中一項會導致另一項。
questions.highlight: Put simply, heavy screen use and poor sleep are connected, but the research did not prove that one causes the other.

questions.prompt: The organisation has a detailed plan, enough money and skilled staff, but nobody has been given final responsibility. The central lesson is that resources are useless without clear ownership.
questions.promptZh: 這個機構擁有詳細計劃、充足資金和具備技能的員工，但沒有人獲賦予最終責任。核心教訓是，如果責任誰屬並不清晰，資源也不能發揮作用。
questions.answer: Put simply, a detailed plan, enough money and skilled staff are useless unless someone has clear final responsibility.

questions.highlight: Put simply, a detailed plan, enough money and skilled staff are useless unless someone has clear final responsibility.
